thread:
maya: heads up — starting ~12:03 UTC we're seeing a big spike in 429s across multiple orgs hitting /v1/generate. dashboards show per-org burst_budget set to 0 for lots of orgs.
liam: omg, I saw the alert. rolling through traces now. any recent console deploys?
irene: yeah console had a rollout last night that toggled the new 'quota tiers' UI flag.
maya: repro: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer REDACTED\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'` gets 429s immediately.
opsbot: Alert: 426 requests/min throttled in last 3m — 47% increase over baseline (svc: api-gateway).
liam: looking at config service — per-org mapping for burst_cap was changed in translation layer. most orgs now map to tier \"default-v2\" which has burst=0.
zane: that's the UI change — when there was no explicit tier mapping the console set default-v2 instead of falling back to legacy defaults. bug introduced in 2026-03-16 deploy.
irene: can we hotfix console to stop writing default-v2 for unset mappings?
liam: for immediate recovery, I'll patch the config service to treat default-v2 as missing and fallback to previous burst value. patching now.
maya: +1 — orgs are customer-facing, starting to get support pings.
deploy-bot: deploy started: config-service patch v2026.03.18-hotfix (#482)
liam: patched and reloaded translation cache. please check dashboards.
opsbot: Notice: throttled requests dropping — 429 rate down from 47% -> 8% in last 2m.
zane: console PR to fix mapping logic: `if (!explicit_tier) use legacy_default_burst()` — tests added.
irene: we should add an integration test to ensure a missing mapping doesn't write a zero burst.
maya: can we run a one-off migration to restore burst budgets for orgs that got set to 0? some have committed dedicated capacity.
liam: yes — running migration script to reset burst to last known-good value from audit log for orgs where burst==0 and last-modified between 2026-03-16T22:00 and 2026-03-17T04:00. will alert when done.
deploy-bot: migration job queued: restore-burst-1806789055
liam: migration finished — 98 orgs updated, 12 orgs intentionally zero (trial accounts). support notified.
maya: customer pings dropping. thanks all. we'll keep this open for 24h for regression monitoring. :thumbsup:
irene: filing postmortem and adding action items: console validation, integration test, audit alert on sudden burst drops.
liam: root cause: console UI flip wrote a non-backwards-compatible default tier for missing mappings; translation layer interpreted that tier as zero-burst. impact: transient throttling for many orgs. mitigation: config patch + migration. followups: console validator + telemetry alert on per-org burst delta > 90%.
maya: closing note: outage window ~12:03–12:08 UTC, ~5 minutes to restore majority, migrations took until 12:30. closing after 24h watch.
